output.summary: The ED length-of-stay rise is almost entirely boarding (about 3.0 of 3.2 hours), not ED work-up time. ED nurse staffing hours per visit, vacancy and grid compliance are flat, so understaffing is contradicted. Bed counts and occupancy are unchanged. Boarding jumped when the March 2026 rounding change took effect. Medical-ward discharges moved later, while surgical wards were unchanged. The 4 West huddle pilot halved boarding on huddle days, and the comparability check ruled out volume and rotation confounds. Door-to-provider and left-without-being-seen rose after the triage provider was cut on 1 May, so that link stays association-only. The September evening bed-cleaning cut is unmeasured. Extend the huddle. Do not defer case managers or pause the pilot.
